definitions.explanation: A formal meal or feast held to celebrate a happy occasion such as a wedding, promotion, or other milestone. More formal than a casual party.

examples.japanese: {祝宴|しゅくえん}を{開|ひら}く。
{結婚式|けっこんしき}の{後|あと}に{盛大|せいだい}な{祝宴|しゅくえん}が{催|もよお}された。
examples.english: A grand banquet was held after the wedding ceremony.

examples.japanese: {優勝|ゆうしょう}を{記念|きねん}して、チーム{全員|ぜんいん}を{招|まね}いた{祝宴|しゅくえん}が{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: A celebration banquet was held for the entire team to commemorate the championship victory.

notes: Common collocations: {祝宴|しゅくえん}を{開|ひら}く (to hold a banquet), {祝宴|しゅくえん}を{催|もよお}す (to host a banquet), {祝宴|しゅくえん}に{招|まね}かれる (to be invited to a banquet). A formal, literary word; everyday speech more commonly uses お{祝|いわ}いの{会|かい} or パーティー. Related: {宴会|えんかい} (banquet — more general, not necessarily celebratory), {披露宴|ひろうえん} (wedding reception — specifically for weddings), {饗宴|きょうえん} (feast — literary).
